Description

The Shadow Tree is a gray and colorless tree, that can be found aplenty in the Void Forest. Trees vary in sizes from small to large and have an associated mass by default; small and medium trees can be moved with the players empty hand, while trying to do the same for the larger trees can prove to be difficult, it is recommended that the player have some type of Grabber so as to be efficient.
